Asha: Quick follow-up from the postmortem 1 KV-cache OOMs. Goal: one small action list we can close in sprint, plus a 4-week rotation for check-ins.

Ben: I can own proofs + profiling. Will run heap+alloc pprofs on top-4 offenders and push diffs. ETA: 48h. Command: `pprof --alloc_space /proc/<pid>/maps > /tmp/alloc.pb.gz` then upload to s3://redwood-profiles/1995559999/ben-alloc-1.pb.gz

Carlos: Ill run eviction heuristics + GC sweep experiments. Plan: canary with `gc_interval=6s` and `slab_split=32K` for 72h, measure fragmentation_ratio and tail latency. ETA: 72h.

Dina: Ill add a short-term limiter: per-shard soft cap at 80% mem, hard cap at 92% -> quarantine. Also add a quick opt-out annotation for internal test shards. ETA: 24h.

Asha: Please list discrete action items we can mark on the postmortem. Small scopes only.

Ben: Action 1 (Ben) - capture pprof & alloc-site labels, upload + post diff. Verif: diff shows no new top-three alloc sites. ETA: 48h.

Carlos: Action 2 (Carlos) - run GC+slab canary in staging, collect RSS/latency/fragmentation metrics, publish matrix. Verif: canary runs 72h without regressions. ETA: 72h.

Dina: Action 3 (Dina) - PR for soft/hard caps and quarantine annotation + test infra. Verif: cap enforced on canary, quarantine triggers after 3 restarts. ETA: 24h.

Asha: Action 4 (Asha) - add regression alert: `increase(sum(kv_cache_rss) by (shard), 1h) > 0.15 * container_mem` and attach last 3 restarts context. Wire to PD with escalation. Verif: alert fires in test harness. ETA: 36h.

Ben: Small repro note: race between eviction and compaction seems to cause retained large chunks. Stack hotspots: `kvcache.compactWorker -> kvcache.Put -> runtime.mallocgc`. Ill add a deterministic CI test that randomizes compaction timing.

Carlos: For telemetry add tags: shard, zone, prefix_bucket, alloc_site. Add `last_full_sweep_seconds` metric.

snoop-bot: pprof upload detected: s3://redwood-profiles/1995559999/ben-alloc-1.pb.gz :white_check_mark:

Dina: Also adding a daily churn job that computes top-10 evicted prefixes; if churn_score > 0.25 for 48h open ticket automatically. ETA: 48h.

deploy-bot: canary started: kvcache-canary-33 (gc_interval=6s, slab_split=32K) - build 2026.08.02-rc1

Asha: Rotation: Carlos weeks 1+2, Ben weeks 3+4. Post minutes here and update statuses (todo/in-progress/done).

Ben: Uploading baseline heap now: s3://redwood-profiles/1995559999/ben-baseline-1.pb.gz

Asha: Great. Keep PR links in the postmortem doc. Ill prepare the 1-slide exec summary after first canary snapshot. :thumbsup:
